supplementalM23.scope: Two ordinary promise/barrier lifecycle cases and one public getter-before-registration case. No initial no-admission policy assertion, private-field/prototype patch or forced kill. Faithful value/error identity, public snapshots and full stats remain checked by exact authored bodies.

runtime.originalVitestPerChildAbi: Not recorded per case; inferred from explicit same Node launcher, not fabricated.

limits: No live source, original test/helper, CLI, guard, archive, counter, dependency/native, Git or canonical qualification edit was made.

Historical M23 expected equivalence is retained as historical metadata. Survival in the original13 or ordinary2 does not establish universal equivalence; a getter case outcome has its own explicit scope.
Only recordedAt is excluded from supplemental snapshots. Real UUIDs and every semantic/stat field remain; no across-phase snapshot-hash or physical-identity equality is asserted.

The new cases exercise public API close/flush, callback barriers and one name getter. They do not establish external producer conformance, authenticated identities, real provider behavior, all races or cross-process concurrency.
Callback capture remains unsigned SELF_REPORTED/NOT_EVALUATED. Faithful callback execution is not measured agent/model ability.
The ten mapping cases are shared with AMC1516. Current13+3 is16, not additional distinct cases to add again to that prior corpus.
No AMC1546 or other old-issue controls, old held runner transfer, full76 batch, wholeP030, Node24, fullsuite, coverage, hostedCI, release, source fix or Done approval is inferred.
